basic_details.job_title: HLL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 55 Associate Manager, Associate Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, the Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, has opened applications for 55 vacancies across 20 posts, from Quality Assurance Officer and Junior Manager to Chief Manager and Deputy General Manager. Nineteen posts are on executive or non-executive fixed-term contract; one, Deputy General Manager (QA & QC) at Kanagala, is permanent. Postings are in Chhattisgarh, Kerala (Thiruvananthapuram, Ernakulam, Kozhikode, Thrissur), Karnataka (Bangalore, Kanagala), Goa, Gujarat, Chennai, and "anywhere in India" for three posts.

how_to_apply: Open the post's page on the HLL careers site and click the Google form link ("Click here to Apply").
Download the prescribed job application form from the link in the Google form or from the HLL website (the careers page lists it as "Blank Application Format").
Fill the form digitally and save it as PDF or Word. Handwritten forms are not accepted. Write the job title and reference code (for example, HLL/HR/092/2026) clearly on the form.
Upload the completed form in the Google form's file-upload field; maximum 10 MB per file.
Attach supporting documents in PDF or Word, each under 10 MB: CV, educational and experience certificates, and your latest salary slip.
Select the correct post in the form's "post applied for" field so the application is routed properly.
Submit on or before 21 October 2026. Late submissions are not considered.
Applications not in the prescribed format are rejected without any further communication, so use HLL's form, not a CV alone.
Check the post's experience rule for your qualification level; most posts require more years from graduates than from postgraduates.
If you work in a Government body or PSU, arrange the NOC now; it is required at the interview.
Everything stated in the form is verified against originals at the interview; a mismatch cancels the candidature at any stage.

content_sections.heading: HLL Lifecare Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: HLL's careers listing gives 1 vacancy for the Teleradiology QA post while that post's own page says 4. Candidates for that post should treat the number as unconfirmed; it does not affect eligibility. The Business Manager (IBD) detail page was not available at the time of writing; its eligibility should be checked on the HLL careers page before applying.

rows.vacancies: 1 on the listing; 4 on the detail page

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Indian nationals only. Age, qualification and experience are all reckoned as on 1 October 2026. The maximum age is set per post (37, 40, 45 or 47) and is listed with each post below. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates get relaxation as per Government of India directives; SC/ST and OBC (non-creamy layer) certificates must be in the format prescribed for Central Government posts. Post-qualification experience is counted after the qualifying degree; several posts set different experience for postgraduates and graduates. Candidates working in Government, semi-Government, PSU or autonomous bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview . For the permanent DGM post, candidates from Central PSUs must have held a post in the scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 (2017) or Rs. 24,900–50,500 (2007) for two years.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Gross salary and annual CTC are HLL's approximate figures at the minimum of the basic pay scale; "Metro" applies to Bangalore postings and "Non-Metro" to the rest. Chief Manager (Healthcare Services), ref. 091 · Chhattisgarh · 1 post · age up to 47 Basic Rs. 50,000–80,000; gross about Rs. 1,01,350; CTC about Rs. 14.26 lakh. Qualification: MBA (Healthcare Management) or MPH, or M.Sc in Medical Microbiology, Medical Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, MLT, Biochemistry, Health Sciences or Zoology, or B.Sc with PGDMLT. Experience: postgraduates 10 years, graduates 12 years, in Government-sector healthcare project management, diagnostic lab management and healthcare camp implementation. Senior Operations Manager (Healthcare Services), ref. 089 · Chhattisgarh 2, Gujarat 1 · age up to 45 Basic Rs. 35,000–65,000; gross about Rs. 70,945; CTC about Rs. 10.07 lakh. Qualification: M.Sc or B.Sc in Medical Biochemistry, Medical Microbiology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology or MLT; MBA (Healthcare Management) or MPH. Experience: postgraduates 6 years, graduates 8 years, managing diagnostic lab operations with multiple centres or labs. Operations Manager (Healthcare Services), ref. 093 · Chhattisgarh · 5 posts · age up to 40 Basic Rs. 30,000–50,000; gross about Rs. 60,810; CTC about Rs. 8.67 lakh. Qualification: as for Chief Manager above. Experience: postgraduates 6 years, graduates 8 years, in Government-sector healthcare project management, diagnostic lab management and camp implementation. Operations Manager (Lab Projects), ref. 095 · Ernakulam · 1 post · age up to 40 Basic Rs. 30,000–50,000; gross about Rs. 60,810; CTC about Rs. 8.67 lakh. Qualification: B.Sc MLT (desirable: M.Sc MLT or MBA). Experience: 4 years' managerial experience in clinical laboratory operations or healthcare project management. Desirable: procurement of reagents and analysers, LIS handling, marketing and business development in diagnostics, and at least one year in a PSU or Government institution as centre in-charge of a diagnostic unit. Operations Manager (Training), ref. 098 · Chhattisgarh · 1 post · age up to 40 Basic Rs. 30,000–50,000; gross about Rs. 60,810; CTC about Rs. 8.67 lakh. Qualification: Master's in MLT or Medical Laboratory Science, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or related field; PhD or PG in laboratory or health sciences an advantage. Experience: 3 years in laboratory management, quality assurance, training management or supervisory roles; NABL / ISO 15189 accreditation experience highly desirable. Associate Manager (Training), ref. 099 · Chhattisgarh · 1 post · age up to 37 Basic Rs. 25,000–45,000; gross about Rs. 50,675; CTC about Rs. 7.28 lakh. Qualification and experience as for Operations Manager (Training), with a minimum of 1 year. content_sections.heading: Pay Structure Explained
content_sections.text: HLL quotes three figures for each executive post: the basic pay range of the scale, the gross monthly salary at the minimum of the scale , and the annual CTC at the minimum . The gross and CTC are approximate and include allowances; they differ between Metro (Bangalore) and Non-Metro postings. Candidates placed above the minimum would earn more than the quoted gross. Contract tenure is not stated on the position pages; the posts are described only as fixed-term contract.

faq.question: Q1. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: No. The position pages refer only to an interview, with documents verified at that stage.

faq.question: Q2. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: Nineteen of the twenty posts are fixed-term contract (executive, or non-executive for QA Officer). Only Deputy General Manager (QA & QC) at Kanagala is permanent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age cut-off date?
faq.answer: 1 October 2026 for every post. The maximum age differs by post: 37 for most Junior and Associate Manager posts, 40 for Operations Manager and Business Manager (Lab In-Charge), 45 for Senior Operations Manager, Senior Business Manager and DGM, and 47 for Chief Manager.

faq.question: Q4. Can freshers apply?
faq.answer: Only for Junior Manager (Diagnostics) in Goa, where graduates may apply without experience. Every other post requires post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What does "gross salary at the minimum of the scale" mean?
faq.answer: It is HLL's approximate monthly gross, including allowances, for a candidate placed at the lowest basic pay of the scale. Bangalore postings use the Metro figure; all others the Non-Metro figure.

faq.question: Q6. Can I submit a handwritten application form?
faq.answer: No. The form must be filled digitally and uploaded as a PDF or Word file through the Google form.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a Government hospital or PSU. What do I need?
faq.answer: A No Objection Certificate from your employer, to be produced at the interview.
